rows.note: Use this for the size or extent of one person's known vocabulary.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 ci4 wui6 loeng6 m4 syun3 do1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a vocabulary or lexicon as a body of words, rather than a formatted list.

example.english: This textbook organizes business vocabulary for students to review.
example.traditional: 呢本教材整理咗商業詞彙，方便學生溫習。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 gaau3 coi4 zing2 lei5 zo2 soeng1 jip6 ci4 wui6 fong1 bin6 hok6 saang1 wan1 zaap6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a prepared vocabulary or word list, especially one used for learning.

example.english: The teacher asked us to memorize the vocabulary list.
example.traditional: 老師叫我哋背熟份詞語表。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 bui3 suk6 fan6 ci4 jyu5 biu2

rows.note: Use this when the vocabulary consists of the specialised terms of a profession or academic field.

example.english: To work in healthcare, you need to know a lot of professional vocabulary.
example.traditional: 做醫護工作，要識好多專業詞彙。
example.jyutping: zou6 ji1 wu6 gung1 zok3 jiu3 sik1 hou2 do1 zyun1 jip6 ci4 wui6
